videos.title: The World's Heaviest Weight
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
How do you measure big forces accurately? 

By calibrating your force transducer on the world's biggest weight - 1,000,000 pounds of force. 

This machine ensures planes don't break apart, jets provide required thrust, and rockets make it to their destination.
